back_translation: The word of the LORD came to me, saying,

“Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre, the Lord GOD says this: Because your heart is proud and you have said, ‘I am a god; I sit on the throne of gods in the heart of the seas,’ yet you are only a man and not a god, though you regard your heart as the heart of a god—
behold, you are wiser than Daniel; no secret is hidden from you.
By your wisdom and understanding you have made wealth for yourself and gathered gold and silver into your treasuries.
By your great skill in trading you have increased your wealth, and your heart has grown proud because of your wealth.
Therefore the Lord GOD says this: Because you regard your heart as the heart of a god,
therefore, behold, I will bring foreigners against you, the most ruthless of nations. They will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom and defile your splendor.
They will bring you down to the Pit, and you will die a violent death in the heart of the seas.
Will you still say, ‘I am a god,’ before those who kill you, when you are only a man and not a god in the hands of those who slay you?
You will die the death of the uncircumcised at the hands of foreigners, for I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.”
Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
“Son of man, take up a lament concerning the king of Tyre and say to him, the Lord GOD says this: You were the seal of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.

You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every kind of precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz, and diamond, beryl, onyx, and jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and emerald, together with gold. Your settings and mountings were made of gold, prepared on the day you were created.
You were an anointed guardian cherub, for I established you. You were on the holy mountain of God; you walked among the fiery stones.
You were blameless in your ways from the day you were created, until wickedness was found in you.
Through your abundant trade you were filled with violence and sinned. So I drove you out in disgrace from the mountain of God, and I destroyed you, O guardian cherub, from among the fiery stones.
Your heart grew proud because of your beauty; you corrupted your wisdom because of your splendor. So I threw you down to the ground; I made you a spectacle before kings.

Because of your many iniquities and your dishonest trade, you defiled your sanctuaries. So I brought fire out from within you; it consumed you, and I turned you to ashes on the ground in the sight of all who saw you.
All among the nations who knew you are appalled at you. You have come to a horrible end, and you will be no more forever.”
Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
“Son of man, set your face against Sidon and prophesy against her.

Say, the Lord GOD says this: Behold, I am against you, O Sidon, and I will be glorified in your midst. They will know that I am the LORD when I execute judgments against her and show My holiness in her.
I will send a plague upon her and make blood flow in her streets; the slain will fall within her by the sword that is against her on every side. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
The house of Israel will no longer have a pricking brier or a painful thorn from all the neighbors around them who treat them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.’

The Lord GOD says this: When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, I will show Myself holy among them in the sight of the nations; and they will dwell in their own land, which I gave to My servant Jacob.

They will dwell there securely, build houses, and plant vineyards; they will dwell securely when I execute judgments on all the neighbors around them who treat them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.”
